title: The Moon and its shapes
examples: Why does the moon look different every night?
Does the moon make its own light?

explain.say: The Moon seems to change its shape during the month.
Now look. These are the phases of the Moon in 3D. Can you see the sunlight and the Earth? Tap any part to hear about it.
At full moon, you see the whole round face of the Moon lit up.
At half moon, you see half of the Moon lit up.
A crescent moon is a thin, curved slice of light.
The Moon makes no light of its own.
Moonlight is sunlight bouncing off the Moon.

faq.q: Why does the moon change shape?
faq.a: The moon orbits the Earth, and we only see the part lit by the Sun. As it moves, we see different amounts of light.
asks: Why does the moon look different every night?
What causes the moon's changing shape?

faq.q: Does the moon make its own light?
faq.a: No. The Moon reflects light from the Sun.
asks: Is the moon bright because it glows?
Where does the moon get its light from?

faq.a: The full moon is the time when the entire face of the moon is lit up for us to see.
asks: When is the moon completely lit?
What does a full moon look like?

faq.a: A crescent moon is when only a thin, curved slice of the Moon is lit. You see it when the Moon is near the Sun in our sky.
asks: What is the little curved moon shape?
When is the moon a thin curve?

faq.q: Does the moon cycle take a set amount of time?
faq.a: Yes, the moon cycle takes about one month to complete all its changes. This is how we track the phases.
asks: How long does the moon cycle last?
Is the moon cycle always the same length?

facts: The moon reflects sunlight; it does not produce its own light.
The full moon happens when the Earth is between the Sun and the Moon.
The phases change because of the changing angles between the Sun, Earth, and Moon.

quiz.say: You see a thin, curved slice of Moon. What is it called?
quiz.why: A thin, curved slice is a crescent moon.

wrong.0: A full moon is a whole, round circle.
wrong.1: A half moon looks like half a circle.

quiz.say: When does the Moon look like a whole, bright circle?
quiz.why: At full moon, the whole face we see is lit by the Sun.

wrong.0: At half moon, only half is lit.
wrong.2: A crescent is just a thin slice.

quiz.say: Where does the Moon's light come from?
quiz.show: 🌙 Where does its light come from?
quiz.why: Sunlight bounces off the Moon. That is moonlight.

wrong.1: The Moon is rock, so it makes no light.
wrong.2: Street lights are far too small to light up the Moon.
